Definition: A control that shows part of a larger area and lets the user move around in it.
The part of the scroll pane that is shown on the screen at one time.
The whole area that a scroll pane holds, including the parts not shown right now.
A bar along the edge of a scroll pane that shows where the view is and can be dragged to move it.
A number that gives an item's place in a list. The first item has index 0.
